No findings.

1. **`Directory.Build.props:10-13` — the `Compile Remove` guard is a no-op.** The SDK's default `Compile` glob is evaluated *after* `Directory.Build.props`, so the Remove matches nothing. Latent today only because the dump dirs were deleted and no csproj sets `EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles` (grep confirmed) — the next dump session breaks the build again, which is precisely what fix #4 claims to prevent.
